title: Work-mode determination
summary: Systematic workflow execution MUST remain the default; lightweight execution MAY be used only for a single small-scope change whose correctness can be established with bounded validation.
instructions: The systematic work mode MUST run an applicable governed workflow such as delivery. Agents MUST select it whenever the request is not demonstrably small-scope.

The lightweight work mode MUST run the governed spotfix workflow. Agents MAY select it only when the operator explicitly requests pan-spotfix, or a prior analysis recommends lightweight remediation under this policy.

An agent MAY propose a gate-waiver follow-up as a spotfix case only when the unmet acceptance criteria are explicitly identified and appear independently bounded. The case MUST still pass the full lightweight eligibility check before implementation.

Agents MUST treat a request as small-scope only when it is one coherent issue or change. The request also needs acceptance criteria that are supplied, or derivable without unresolved product or architecture decisions. Existing repository checks MUST be enough to validate it.

Small-scope core implementation MUST affect no more than three implementation files inside one module or bounded subsystem. Test files, documentation, generated projections, and the required escalation inbox item do not count toward that limit.

Small-scope work MUST NOT need a cross-module redesign, a public contract or schema migration, or a dependency strategy change. It MUST NOT need a security or permission redesign, a broad concurrency change, a release-process redesign, or structural performance remediation.

Agents MAY treat syntax, import, build, symbol-resolution, localized logical, focused test-coverage, localized governance, and residual validation issues as typical lightweight candidates. That treatment applies only when every other condition is met. Broad or structurally caused performance problems MUST route to systematic work.
If investigation reveals that any small-scope condition is false or uncertain, the recommended work mode MUST be systematic.
